name: pharm-atlas
description: A retro desktop medication scheduler, inventory tracker, and vitals log.
author: Daniel Uribe

scripts.screenshots:iphone: npm run mobile:build && electron tests/full-demo.cjs --device iphone --capture-dir docs/app-store/screenshots/iphone
scripts.screenshots:ipad: npm run mobile:build && electron tests/full-demo.cjs --device ipad --capture-dir docs/app-store/screenshots/ipad
scripts.cap:sync: npm run mobile:build && cap sync && node scripts/fix-capacitor-spm-paths.js
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run mobile:build && cap add ios && node scripts/fix-capacitor-spm-paths.js
